## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The report's confidence field is populated from ChoiceAnswer.probabilities...

The system SHALL ensure that the report's confidence field is populated from ChoiceAnswer.probabilities and the existing 0.5/0.8 bucketing code is unchanged, asserted by a test over a session-log fixture.

#### Scenario: The report's confidence field is populated from ChoiceAnswer.probabilities...

WHEN `judge-decision-tag-backfill-in-explore-feature` is implemented
THEN The report's confidence field is populated from ChoiceAnswer.probabilities and the existing 0.5/0.8 bucketing code is unchanged, asserted by a test over a session-log fixture.

### Requirement: A decision matching no capability yields the "none" option and is excluded...

The system SHALL ensure that a decision matching no capability yields the "none" option and is excluded from proposed edits.

#### Scenario: A decision matching no capability yields the "none" option and is excluded...

WHEN `judge-decision-tag-backfill-in-explore-feature` is implemented
THEN A decision matching no capability yields the "none" option and is excluded from proposed edits.

### Requirement: All decisions in one session-log phase are answered in a single batched...

The system SHALL ensure that all decisions in one session-log phase are answered in a single batched call, asserted by a call-count test.

#### Scenario: All decisions in one session-log phase are answered in a single batched...

WHEN `judge-decision-tag-backfill-in-explore-feature` is implemented
THEN All decisions in one session-log phase are answered in a single batched call, asserted by a call-count test.

### Requirement: The keyword map remains as the fallback and the script still only proposes...

The system SHALL ensure that the keyword map remains as the fallback and the script still only proposes edits for agent review; no file is written by the script itself.

#### Scenario: The keyword map remains as the fallback and the script still only proposes...

WHEN `judge-decision-tag-backfill-in-explore-feature` is implemented
THEN The keyword map remains as the fallback and the script still only proposes edits for agent review; no file is written by the script itself.
